full_page.content:
1932, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5,
Blank page
May Mrs. Mary Reynolds of Clinton, Ontario - Epileptic Fits .... Ella Threse - head aches, etc. Anna Schutza - eye aches
Mrs. Vanderzyppe - 60 - cancer of Stom.
Clarice Tousignant - 4 - pneumonia & Assedosia
Mrs. Susan Mergart - losing home for taxes. Three little children. Young man - sailor - Father a Captain at 17 enlists on ocean steam- er - has recourse to cursing - is saved by crucifix, worn in fulfil- ment of promise made to dying mother.
Mrs. Eliz. Smith - about 65 - of Lenox, Mich. - "hopeless cancer."
Three young men out of work - boarding mistress can not turn them out - decent young men ...
Mrs. Hogan ... Sickness, etc ... working now but little girl to make 1st Communion - sick
Wm. & Rose Carpenter
Blank Page
Page 37 Page 38 May 22 Jermaine - Dr. Jacques - operation Baby Briski - 18 mon. double rupture. Wm. Landry - 28 - (Heart) bronchitis Tillie Monski - 23 - Kiefer Hosp. - non C. - T.B. Percy Morton - Start in business - Signer ... Mrs. Cunningham - cancer - hand in wringer, Marg. Dionne - operation Friday ....? Mrs. Gordon Dionne - divorce case Thursday -lying.
Page 25 Page 36
